item.title: Recovering Lost Gaming Memories From Plays.tv
Why You Might Actually Like Baseball (Or Baseball = Chessboxing?)
item.description:
Introduction

I have a bizarre fascination with reading about the death of baseball. Fans, pundits, and media alike all bring their own flavor of discussion to the table, but a few agreed upon facts have emerged; baseball is less popular and less watched than 20 years ago, and yet while paradoxically overall team value has persisted (and hence the future is not totally bleak), it feels like there’s a real and pervasive anxiety about where things are headed and what the solutions may be.
